question: Silappadikaram, a famous Tamil epic, was composed by:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ilango Adigal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Silappadikaram** is one of the five great epics of Tamil literature, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It was composed by **Ilango Adigal**, a renowned poet and a prince of the Chera dynasty.
 
• The epic narrates the story of Kannagi, a woman who seeks justice for her husband, and highlights themes of love, morality, and social justice.
 
• Silappadikaram is significant for its intricate portrayal of the lives and customs of ancient Tamils, including their arts, music, and dance.
 
• The work has been influential in shaping Tamil literature and has inspired many later literary and artistic expressions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ilango Adigal**: He is not only the author of Silappadikaram but also a key figure in Tamil literary history, believed to have lived in the 2nd century CE.
 
• **Structure of the Epic**: Silappadikaram is divided into three parts: the story of Kannagi, the tale of Kovalan, and the ultimate fate of Kannagi, emphasizing moral lessons and societal values.
 
• **Other Notable Figures**:
 
 
• **Chathanar**: Known for composing the epic *Manimekalai*, another important Tamil literary work.
 
• **Thiruvalluvar**: Celebrated for his work *Tirukkural*, which is a collection of couplets on ethics, politics, and love.
 
• **Kalidas**: A revered Sanskrit poet and playwright, he is known for his works like *Shakuntala* and *Meghaduta*, but he is not associated with Tamil literature.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Impact**: Silappadikaram has influenced not just literature but also dance and theater, with many performances inspired by its narrative and themes.
 
• **Historical Context**: The epic reflects the socio-political conditions of its time, shedding light on the lives and struggles of women in ancient Tamil society.
